stories.name: Opening
stories.snippet:
const Opening = (args, context) =>
  renderGameTable(
    quoridorGameClient.presentation,
    TWO_PLAYER_SIDES,
    args,
    context
  );
stories.description: The start: South moves first, ten walls each, the move tool chosen.

stories.name: Your Turn
stories.snippet:
const YourTurn = (args, context) =>
  renderGameTable(
    quoridorGameClient.presentation,
    TWO_PLAYER_SIDES,
    args,
    context
  );
stories.description: Mid-game on South's turn: walls on the board, fewer left to place.

stories.name: Waiting For Opponent
stories.snippet:
const WaitingForOpponent = (args, context) =>
  renderGameTable(
    quoridorGameClient.presentation,
    TWO_PLAYER_SIDES,
    args,
    context
  );
stories.description: North is deciding: the board is read-only and the tools are off.

stories.name: Watching
stories.snippet:

  renderGameTable(
    quoridorGameClient.presentation,
    TWO_PLAYER_SIDES,
    args,

stories.description: A watcher follows the game from outside it.

stories.name: Won

  renderGameTable(
    quoridorGameClient.presentation,
    TWO_PLAYER_SIDES,
    args,
    context
  );
stories.description: South reached the opposite home row and won.

stories.name: Lost
stories.snippet:

  renderGameTable(
    quoridorGameClient.presentation,

stories.description: North's side of the same game: South got there first.

setup.name: setup

hand.name: hand
hand.description:
The viewer's own hand, for a game whose authority deals hands; `null`
for a watcher and for every other game. A board never receives another
side's hand.

committed.name: committed
committed.description:
In a game with private commitments: the sides that have committed in the
phase open now (everyone sees which, never what), and the viewer's own
commitment, `null` until they make one. Empty and `null` otherwise.

screens-games-word-tiles-puzzle.name: WordTilesPuzzlePlayerView

stories.name: Ready
stories.description: A fresh attempt: the target, the frozen board and the rack.

stories.name: After A Move
stories.description: The last move fell short: its score against the target.

stories.name: Disabled
stories.description: The attempt is over: the board shows, but no tile can be placed.

stories.name: Word List Unavailable
stories.description: The word list did not load: retry makes placement available again.

stories.name: Retry Word List
stories.description: Retry resolves the unavailable word list without replacing the player.

stories.name: Unreadable
stories.description: A definition this app cannot read offers the real library destination.

stories.name: Place A Word
stories.description: E and A placed under TOE spell a word the list lacks: the preview says so.

stories.name: Reach Target
stories.description: A real placement is scored by the domain evaluator and fed back into the player.

stories.name: Enlarged Blank
stories.description: Assign a blank through the enlarged board and retain its chosen letter.

screens-games-word-tiles-puzzle.description:
A one-move Word Tiles challenge, presentational: the target, the last
move's score, the frozen board and the rack, the move's preview against
the word list, and play or recall. `WordTilesPuzzlePlayer` loads the word
list the puzzle pins.
